questions.text: What is the CRC value read (hex, as to whether it is 0x00000000 or the INIT state 0xFFFFFFFF)? (Scenario: After INIT, a PUSH_N is written with TAIL_LEN 0, then CRC, BYTE_COUNT and BUSY_CYCLES are read.) Two careful readers of the requirements disagree about this; what is the intended behaviour?

What BYTE_COUNT value is read after reset? (Scenario: Midway through a message, with 5 PUSH4 done (BYTE_COUNT 20), rst is asserted for 1 clk while a PUSH4 is written in that same clock; after release BYTE_COUNT and CRC are read.) Two careful readers of the requirements disagree about this; what is the intended behaviour?
